protocol: One CPU fit on the original unaugmented setwise mixtures. Add trailing local-peak contrast, detuning and cross-partial coherence to the unchanged 62-coordinate prefix. Training-only cutoff, original roles, objective, optimizer, epochs and all acceptance gates remain fixed.

training_plan_identity.encoding: SHA256 of decompressed JSON bytes; gzip timestamp excluded

harmonic_peak_contrast.name: harmonic_peak_contrast_v1
harmonic_peak_contrast.peak_rule: largest local maximum with interpolated frequency within the fixed neighborhood
harmonic_peak_contrast.no_peak: nominal-frequency power and flank contrast; offset=0, valid=0
harmonic_peak_contrast.coherence: power-weighted standard deviation of valid partial offsets in cents; zero for fewer than two
harmonic_peak_contrast.flank_rule: mean linear power at peak +/- three native FFT bins; negative frequency reflected
harmonic_peak_contrast.normalization: original trailing-window RMS; training-only coordinate scaling

stage: Frozen implementation and one independent static review passed; ready for one CPU dispatch
bulk_policy: Collect the small report once with server digest verification; retain model, predictions and mixture plans remote. No automatic rerun or cutoff tuning.

validation.independent_static_review: No material blocker; peak math/layout, train-only fitting, unchanged gates and workflow checked. Torch execution and CPU budget pending GitHub.
